steps.text: Reported playing on D3DMetal with engine x64-crossover26.3-r7 (highball-db#22, M5, macOS 27.0, 5 of 5). The reporter says the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines do not run it, so the recipe asks for r7. Highball asks for Apple's licence the first time D3DMetal is used.
Do not switch this game to DXMT for now: it needs DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 to show a window, and with that set the reporter's Mac kernel-panicked. Not reproduced by the maintainer.

knownIssues.symptom: On DXMT with DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 the whole Mac kernel-panics (reported on an M5, macOS 27.0, engine r7)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; the panic log names the watchdog timer, which is what fires when the GPU driver stops responding
knownIssues.fix: use D3DMetal, which the recipe sets

knownIssues.symptom: Does not run on the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines
knownIssues.fix: the recipe asks for engine x64-crossover26.3-r7
